issue.title: [Marvell-arm64] Sonic install gives illegal character error

resolution.description:
fixes #18681

#### Why I did it
Fix sonic installer issues for marvell-arm64 platform. Following fixes are part of change,
- Fix illegal character error
- Set second image based on current image
- Fix boot_once uboot environment variable
- Fix print boot menu

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
Changed the platform.conf scripts which sets uboot environment variables.

#### How to verify it
Tested following cases to verify the issue,
 - sonic-installer install
 - sonic-installer set-next-boot
 - sonic-installer set-default
